fields.subtitle: Reunification plan
fields.incident: School bus crash on Route 9 with 41 students aboard

flow.purpose: Parents line up; greeters hand out reunification cards
Photo identification checked against the roster and release card
Runner brings the student from the holding room
Guardian and student meet; release log signed
Commander and counselor handle cases that do not fit

rules: Release only to an adult on the student's release card, verified by photo identification.
No release by phone or by assertion.
Unverified cases go to the exceptions zone.
fields.support: Counselors and a nurse sit in the quiet room; two interpreters at check-in.
